name: Hunter's Crown
source:
"THERE'S ONLY ONE CROWN, AND THERE CAN ONLY BE ONE KING."


Midwest Exclusion Zone, 2059. You are a contestant on a monster-hunting reality show. But when the first challenge goes horribly wrong, you end up trapped in a bunker with your fellow competitors – and a new, terrifying type of beast.

[From [url=https://digital-ayanna.itch.io/hunters-crown]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“只有一顶王冠，也只能有一位国王。”


中西部禁区，2059年。你是怪物狩猎真人秀节目的参赛者。但当第一个挑战出现严重错误时，你最终会和你的竞争对手一起被困在地堡里——还有一种新的、可怕的野兽。

[来自[url=https://digital-ayanna.itch.io/hunters-crown]itch.io[/url]]
